content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the CUSAT Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 15-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of CUSAT to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CUSAT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online submission of applications for the CUSAT Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts is 15th September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: For the Assistant Professor post, candidates need a Master's degree in Mathematics with 55% marks and must have qualified NET/CSIR or possess a Ph.D. in the relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for an Associate Professor at CUSAT?
faq.answer: The selected Associate Professor will receive a consolidated salary of ₹1,25,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How can I apply for the CUSAT recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official CUSAT website, followed by sending a hard copy of the application with supporting documents to the Registrar.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for CUSAT recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, the application fee is ₹950/- for General category candidates and ₹195/- for SC/ST category candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the experience required for the Associate Professor position?
faq.answer: Associate Professor candidates need 12 years of relevant experience, with at least 2 years as a Chief Engineer officer onboard merchant ships.

faq.question: Q7. Does CUSAT offer contract positions?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment for Associate Professor and Assistant Professor posts is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article, labeled as 'Official Notification PDF'.

faq.question: Q9. What is the pay scale for an Assistant Professor without a Ph.D.?
faq.answer: Assistant Professors without a Ph.D. will receive a monthly remuneration of ₹45,000/-.

faq.question: Q10. What is the total number of vacancies announced by CUSAT?
faq.answer: The provided data indicates 0 vacancies for both Associate Professor and Assistant Professor positions.
